sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 510. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 510. Success value 100. 10x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Lethargy for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frail for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Increases Ability cooldown times by 50% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Extend which increases the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 10 seconds for one time only. [Demerit]
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000

[Humanoid Shuuki] Aoba Wakura or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
